authorship: Independent CHECK-1, CHECK-12 and FORMULA-9 examples. Tables, findings and complete verification records are authored here; no candidate observation or retiring evaluator supplied expected truth.

lookup-when.specification:
yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: TEST
base: SRC
keys: [ID]
input:
  SRC: src.csv
  DONOR: {path: donor.csv, types: {SEQ: int, X: int}}
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, VALUE]}
intermediates:
  - id: P
    dataset: DONOR
    key: [ID]
    order_by: [DONOR.SEQ]
    keep: first
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: str, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - {name: VALUE, type: int, derivation: 2}
verifications:
  - assert: {id: selected, when: "P.X = 2", require: "VALUE = 2"}
  - row_count: {min: 3, max: 3}
